contour_span: first voiced frame through last voiced frame, divided into equal thirds

word_prominence.combination: mean within-utterance z score over available dimensions

evaluation.focus_recovery: top-prominence aligned word appears in any comma-separated perceived-focus phrase
evaluation.expressive_label: any speech-act label other than neutral-statement
evaluation.cluster_statistic: mean expressive-neutral distance minus pooled same-label distance
evaluation.permutation_test: exact over every label assignment preserving observed class counts
evaluation.directional_success: positive cluster statistic and exact p <= 0.10

interpretation: descriptive pilot only; no classifier, affect detector, or production selector claim
publication: derived aggregate only; audio, alignments, labels, and item-level fingerprints stay private
